troubleshooting_summary:
Root symptoms: streamed JSON chunks can split structural tokens (opening/closing braces, quotes) which breaks naive incremental parsers. Secondary: when function_call mode is used, final assembled call object may not match their strict schema because the model injects optional fields or uses different property ordering.

Immediate recommended approaches provided to customer: 
- Use line-delimited JSON (NDJSON) or explicit event wrappers per top-level object so incremental parser can process by line rather than raw bytes.
- If using function/tool calling, set strict function schema on the request and also accept versioning differences; add a small schema-tolerant layer (ignore unknown fields, validate required props only).
- For streaming + structured output, recommend sending `stream: true` but emit full JSON tokens inside each chunk (server-side workaround) OR collect until a stable delimiter ("<<END_JSON>>") then parse.
- Provide sample Node code that buffers until a \n-terminated JSON line, not until bracket balance — this is more robust across splits.
- If customer needs guaranteed atomic JSON per chunk, escalate to infra (RED-7891) to investigate chunking behavior and SSE boundary policy on hosted nodes.
